items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
Experience with cleaning solvents, soaps, waxes and other related chemicals used in custodial work.

Under the general supervision of the Custodial Supervisor, this position is responsible for maintaining a clean, safe, and sanitary environment throughout assigned campus facilities in support of the university's teaching, research, and public service mission. The position performs a wide range of custodial duties, including cleaning classrooms, laboratories, offices, corridors, restrooms, and other public spaces; collecting trash and recycling; floor care, dusting, and replenishing restroom supplies. This position also responds to building and custodial emergencies, reports facility deficiencies, performs basic building security responsibilities, and operates custodial equipment safely and efficiently. In addition, this position maintains custodial equipment and supply areas, travels between assigned buildings, participates in departmental meetings, and supports special assignments and emergency response activities as needed.
